Products PG Paper specialises in various papers including graphical, packaging and speciality grades from our mill partners across the world. We can offer personalised solutions to meet your paper and board needs and are always happy to discuss your requirements to provide the most suitable paper including graphical, packaging and specially sourced grades from mills and paper manufacturers in the UK and worldwide. Delivery Our various global warehousing facilities are strategically placed, making us an ideal choice for customers and suppliers. Our experienced team strive to offer flexible collection and delivery terms across the globe and personally manages each shipment with outstanding customer care and dedication. Payment As an international paper trading company we are affiliated with the world leaders of trade-related credit insurance. We work closely with these agencies to offer you flexibility and peace of mind to create a hassle-free payment process with every transaction. Our Products We have a deep understanding of the global marketplace, offering a range of paper and packaging products through our global mill partners, providing printing, packaging, pulp and speciality paper in both prime and warehouse stock quality. We have built partnerships with numerous deep-sea producers, which allows us to source our pulp, paper and packaging grades from all across the globe. PG Paper has been awarded an FSC® certification, certified for Chain of Custody (COC), and complies with the highest environmental standards in the market. PG Paper works with sustainable products obtained from well-managed forests and drives forward our focus on sustainable development. Read more about our FSC® certification award here . Contact our business development team for more information on our pulp, paper and packaging product portfolio. Learn more about our products Our Prime Paper For over 20 years, we have curated a portfolio of high-quality brands from around the world, offering prime paper and board solutions. As a trusted sourcing partner, we deliver A-grade papers in graphical, packaging, tissue, speciality, and pulp . Working with global mill partners, we provide tailor-made solutions to meet specific application and machine requirements, ensuring suitability and quality for our customers. Learn more about our prime paper solutions Our Global Warehouse Stock We are a global provider of warehouse stock, regularly exporting paper and board solutions worldwide. Our inventory includes graphical, packaging, and speciality products stored across a global warehouse network, ensuring consistent supply to meet customer requirements. PG Paper offers a wide range of stock solutions, with a knowledgeable team dedicated to understanding needs and providing options based on specifications, budget, and location. Our in-house logistics team manages all documentation, ensuring seamless logistical support. Learn more about our warehouse stock Our Partners PG Paper maintains strong relationships with mills and paper manufacturers in the UK and globally. We partner with international mills to deliver value-added services, helping them expand into new markets by consulting on export strategies and brand positioning. We purchase ongoing prime capacity and warehouse stocks, as well as offer solutions for spot opportunities to meet customer needs. As part of our full-service approach, PG Paper also provides financing and risk management, supporting our partners on a global scale. CYBER CRIME WARNING Cyber criminals are getting more and more sophisticated and it is noted that spoofing and phishing is on the increase. PG Paper is taking this issue very seriously and would recommend the following advice: Never make payments to bank accounts other than the account indicated in the original PG Paper invoice Always contact your PG Paper representative if you receive any requests to make payments to alternative accounts, requests to submit sensitive information or other behaviour that you find suspicious. Our bank details have not changed recently Should you be unsure of bank details please seek verification from us using at least two methods. For example - phone and email confirmation Please do not seek such confirmation from a mobile number starting +44 7xxx xxxxxx PG Paper will not be held responsible for anyone sending money to another bank account For further information please contact your PG Paper representative on our office number which is +44 1505 874 266 Commitment We are professional, dedicated and multilingual team personally work from order to delivery to fulfil every aspect of your requirements, adding value and providing peace of mind with every transaction. Our knowledge ensures we can collect and deliver in any corner of the world with confidence. Service PG Paper aim to offer a win-win situation for our clients, paper manufacturers and mills. The PG Paper team are able to provide a personalised service and hassle free experience for our clients and mill partners using our industry knowledge and dedication to customer service. With our expert team members specialising in a range of roles from procurement, sales, logistics, documentation and finance, we are certain we can add value to your organisation.
